Variants.Content: Roderic has a limited following whose households may seek separate protection. Cooperation needs safety, food and a service end point.

Roderic’s limited following may seek separate protectors. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Cooperation needs defined safety, supply and service duration.
